title: Locating Answer-Correctness Signals in Frozen Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.37700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models expose internal signals that predict whether an answer is correct, readable from a single forward pass of a frozen model without additional generations. Yet existing probes often commit to one signal family or layer and can be brittle under distribution shift; in retrieval-augmented settings, many specialized detectors instead target passage faithfulness, which can diverge from correctness when retrieved evidence is unhelpful or conflicting. We therefore ask where answer correctness is readable, which internal signal families carry it, and how they should be combined. We search over hidden states, token probabilities, residual-stream features, attention, and their fusion, treating the selected readouts as a predictive measurement rather than a mechanistic localization. We run this analysis separately in closed-book and with-context settings, since context can change which readouts are informative. A consistent anatomy eme

translated_title: 在冻结的大型语言模型中定位答案正确性信号
translated_abstract: 语言模型内部暴露出能够预测答案是否正确的信号，这些信号可以在不进行额外生成的情况下，通过冻结模型的单次前向传播读取出来。然而，现有的探测方法往往只依赖单一的信号族或单层，在分布偏移下可能表现脆弱；在检索增强的场景中，许多专用检测器转而针对段落忠实性进行判断，而当检索到的证据无用或相互冲突时，忠实性可能与正确性产生分歧。因此，我们探究答案正确性在何处可被读取、哪些内部信号族承载了这一信息，以及应当如何组合这些信号。我们在隐藏状态、词元概率、残差流特征、注意力机制及其融合中进行搜索，将所选的读取方式视为一种预测性测量，而非机制层面的定位。我们分别在闭卷和有上下文两种设置下进行分析，因为上下文可能改变哪些读取方式更具信息量。一个一致的内部结构图景逐渐显现……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文系统性地探索了冻结大语言模型中多种内部信号（隐藏状态、词元概率、残差流特征、注意力及其融合）以定位答案正确性信号，并分别在闭卷与有上下文两种设置下分析信号的可读性与组合方式。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically searches multiple internal signal families (hidden states, token probabilities, residual-stream features, attention, and their fusion) in frozen LLMs to locate answer-correctness signals, analyzing closed-book and with-context settings separately and determining how these signals should be combined.
